_note: Candidate registry for Minnesota 2026. Every record comes from the state's official list of candidates for the November 3, 2026 general election (Minnesota Secretary of State, What's On My Ballot (Minnesota Voting Information Portal), 11/03/2026 State General Election ballot data and official sample ballots, one precinct per congressional district, linked in source_url; a race from another official list links it in roster_source_url). Names and party labels are as the list prints them (mixed case where the list prints capitals). Nothing in a record is invented: no bios, photos, websites or fundraising.
_source: Minnesota Secretary of State, What's On My Ballot (Minnesota Voting Information Portal), 11/03/2026 State General Election ballot data and official sample ballots, one precinct per congressional district (https://myballotmn.sos.mn.gov/); sitting members matched to congress.gov (bioguide_id).
